source: lab (captured, background replaced by Segment Anything 2 demo)

camera.evidence: mean abs frame diff in the table region 0.03-0.5 grey levels while nothing moves (frames 1-24); table outline fixed
camera.perspective: camera looks down at ~30-40 deg onto a table top; table top is a trapezoid narrower at the back (top edge ~y 244, ~320-340 px wide) than at the front (y ~415-437, ~420 px wide) -> back of table farther from camera. Image y increasing = toward camera on the table plane.

tennis_ball_left.desc: yellow-green tennis ball, starts at the LEFT corner of the table (x~468,y~287); rolls right, passes behind the top of the soccer ball, hits the other tennis ball at frame 38, rebounds back left/up and ends mostly hidden behind the top of the soccer ball

tennis_ball_right.desc: yellow-green tennis ball, starts at the BACK-RIGHT corner of the table (x~819,y~257); rolls left and slightly toward camera, hits the left ball at frame 38, then rolls toward the camera and slightly right (down-right in image), still moving at the end

soccer_ball.desc: black-and-white football on the table, left of centre
soccer_ball.note: occludes the left tennis ball from frame ~31 on

pencil_case.desc: orange-yellow elongated pencil case / sponge, lying diagonally right of the soccer ball
pencil_case.note: axis rises to the right (~23 deg from horizontal); left end ~(648,380), right end ~(738,330)

table.desc: wooden table top with single dark central leg/pedestal
table.note: segmentation trims some table edges (notch at right edge near y 270-290 in later frames, left corner where ball A starts)

table_leg.desc: dark grey leg below the table centre

events.note: first clear displacement at frame 25 (+4 px); launched by an unseen push (hand not in segmented video)
first clear displacement at frame 25 (-5 px)

events.event: left ball starts passing behind soccer ball
dropped capture frame (double step for both balls)
events.note: displacement 35->36 is ~2x neighbours for both balls although timestamps are uniform

events.event: collision of the two tennis balls
events.note: centre separation 50 px at 37, ~30.5 px at 38 (= sum of radii), both reverse direction afterwards

events.event: after collision: left ball moves back left/up slowly, right ball moves down-right
video ends with both balls still moving slowly

apparent_size_vs_time: tennis ball diameters stay ~30-33 px all clip (A ~31-33, B ~29.5-32); no clear trend -> depth changes are small. Ball B moves toward the camera after the collision (y increasing).
